description: WP-O5 Codex: Orks (11e) 'ARDBOYZ (Green Tide Upgrade, Boyz unit; models in this unit have a Save characteristic of 4+) — passive, applied by the list-build pass when the army is processed (ArmyListManager -> OrkEnhancements11e.apply_list_build). Fixture ork11e_enh_green_tide: Boyz C carry the Upgrade, Boyz D do not. Hovering Boyz C (real cursor) shows the board model-stats card with Sv 4+; Boyz D show 5+.

steps.comment: 'Ardboyz (list-build, applied when the army was loaded): Boyz C have Sv 4+; Boyz D (no Upgrade) keep 5+
the board model-stats card for Boyz C shows Sv:4+
